cover.prompt: Upon the stone watchpost terrace on the steep slopes of Mount Phyle, mercenary-3 in an oxblood red tunic leans forward with spine tensed 15 degrees into the breeze, shading his brow with one hand while holding a bronze spear upright away from his chest with elbow flared out 20 degrees; beside him mercenary-4 in olive green stands poised in a wide 3/4 stance, holding an open dispatch tube clear of his hip as both scan the zigzagging mountain trail far below for an overdue messenger; the corner of an ashlar watchpost parapet anchors the right frame margin; the steep terraced mountain ridges drop sharply to the glinting sea under warm, crisp directional sunlight, silhouettes isolated against the sunlit rock face.
cover.others: a messenger raven perched on the watchpost roof.
